input: A fixed offline planning request entering M4 through the public interaction route.
expected_stage_behavior: Expose the M2 route, Task Graph, Task Results, Evidence, Candidates and plan boundary.
expected_failure_or_success_semantics: A plan is only reported as a plan when the public route and downstream chain actually run; current semantic gaps remain visible.
human_assertions: The output contains the M2 route decision used by M4.
The Task Graph and Task Results are tied to the same snapshot and trace.
A route bypass or missing task is observable as a failure.
mutation_target: Bypass the public Router or remove a required task in an isolated variant.
independent_review_prompt: Review the public route and downstream graph without accepting a summary-only result.
